subject: Mobile Development
subcategory: Famous Apps That Changed the World
title: DoorDash and Food Delivery Wars
description: A quick win: understand DoorDash and Food Delivery Wars.

hook.text: Why cook when any restaurant in town can deliver to your door in 30 minutes?

buildup.text: DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub turned local restaurants into delivery businesses.

discovery.text: COVID lockdowns turned food delivery from a convenience into a necessity overnight.

twist.text: Most delivery apps lose money. They subsidize orders with investor capital to gain market share.

climax.text: Food delivery changed dining habits forever but created an industry still searching for profit.

punchline.text: Convenient for diners; unprofitable for companies.

quiz.question: What challenge do most food delivery apps face?
options: They lose money and struggle to reach profitability
